description: Get collateral balances for a wallet (PM by default; include="all" returns every active supported collateral on the chain). Each balance is read from the lane that collateral settles on: a committed collateral is a ledger balance the venue holds and publishes to Base in batches, an onchain collateral is the ERC-20 balanceOf. Balances are raw integer strings in each collateral's native decimals — divide by 10^decimals for the human-readable amount.

chainId.description: Active chain to query. Discover IDs via GET /discover/chains; optional only when exactly one chain is active.

include.description: default returns the PM balance only. all returns every active supported collateral on the chain.

name: problee_get_balance
title: Get token balances for a wallet
